name: adtest-mcp
description: Score an image, video or text ad on 13 effectiveness dimensions before you spend on media: one `analyze_advert` tool returns the score, a section-by-section report and concrete fixes.

ADTEST_API_KEY.description: AdTest.AI developer API key (app.adtest.ai → Developer → Generate key). Each successful analysis costs 1 credit.

tools.name: analyze_advert
tools.description: Run an AI-only analysis of an advert and get a detailed scoring report. Provide exactly one of url (public image/video URL), file_path (local image/video) or text (ad copy); optional brand_url improves brand detection. Video is supported and may take a few minutes.

url.description: Public URL of an image or video advert

file_path.description: Local path to an image or video file to upload

examples.title: Score a video ad
examples.description: Analyse a public video advert and get the 13-dimension report
examples.prompt: Analyse this ad and tell me the three biggest fixes: https://example.com/spot.mp4

examples.title: Compare two headlines
examples.description: Score ad copy variants and pick the stronger one
examples.prompt: Score these two ad copies for a running-shoe launch and tell me which to run: (A) ... (B) ...
